site.heroPromise: Made to solve real problems without losing the fun.
site.explorerTitle: Pick an app. Follow your curiosity.
site.explorerSubtitle: Every Kortex app has its own personality, but they all share one goal: make the useful parts of your day feel surprisingly good.
site.futureBody: The Kortex platform is designed as a living collection. New apps can plug into the same playful discovery system without turning the experience into a crowded app directory.
site.futureBadge: Room for the next great Kortex idea

capybara-grove.tagline: Run a cozy cafe in an animal town
capybara-grove.description: A cozy cafe-management and life-simulation game where you harvest, cook, serve guests, clean up, and grow your grove.
capybara-grove.feature1: Harvest and cook through a day

dreamquiet.description: An adult, non-medical sleep-aid and room-sound observation app with local playback, protected recordings, and rough sleep ranges.
dreamquiet.feature3: Local clips with keep, delete, and share controls

lesson-nook.tagline: Plan a preschool week with confidence
lesson-nook.description: A private, on-device notebook for one preschool classroom, with age-layered activities, routines, attendance, and family-ready PDFs.
lesson-nook.feature1: 53 offline week slots and five weekdays
lesson-nook.feature2: Activities for three Florida age bands
lesson-nook.feature3: Classroom notes, attendance, and family sheets

untwist.tagline: Untangle every cord, one peg at a time
untwist.description: A portrait tactile logic game where you move pegs into empty sockets until the cords no longer cross.
untwist.feature2: Daily, Free Play, Sprint, and Twist Lab modes
untwist.feature3: Undo, layered hints, mastery stars, and local sessions

contacts.tagline: Clean up your address book safely
contacts.description: A privacy-first contacts organizer that standardizes phone numbers, finds duplicates, and keeps backups on your device.

captions.tagline: Turn your photos into captions that sound like you
captions.description: An AI photo assistant that analyzes images and helps shape social captions around your writing voice.

filters.tagline: Give every photo a new direction
filters.description: An AI photo editor that applies custom and preset transformations through a cloud-backed editing flow.

trails.tagline: Find trails and follow the ride
trails.description: A map-focused outdoor app for discovering trails, saving routes, tracking rides, and reporting hazards.

routes.tagline: Rehearse the route before the first stop
routes.description: A local-first driver route rehearsal app with offline stop cards, audio reveals, spaced-priority quizzes, and printable route cards.
routes.feature3: Local route data and printable cards

haul.tagline: Compare the pay before you haul
haul.description: A local-first CDL pay and offer calculator for entering, comparing, and saving estimates from your own assumptions.

clock.tagline: Keep shifts, rules, and attendance in one place
clock.description: A local-first shift and attendance policy tracker for schedules, workplace rules, attendance notes, and wake-up alarms.

route-rush.tagline: Trace the route. Beat the clock.
route-rush.description: A deterministic route puzzle where you plan and validate paths through score-focused levels.

shiftpocalypse.tagline: Make the call. Survive the shift.
shiftpocalypse.description: A deterministic workday strategy game where your decisions shape each shift and your career progress.
shiftpocalypse.feature3: One optional continue after a failed shift

backstage-ops.description: An offline park-transit management simulation balancing crowd demand, routes, vehicles, staff, accessibility, weather, and reliability.
backstage-ops.feature3: Deterministic opening, midday, and closing phases

bowl.tagline: Bowl a full game, one frame at a time
bowl.description: A portrait bowling game with ten-frame scoring, touch throws, progression goals, and challenge mastery.

numbers.tagline: Match numbers and clear the lane
numbers.description: A portrait number-matching puzzle where you tap or drag tiles to targets, clear rows, and build combos.

pulse-stack.tagline: Time the pulse. Build the stack.
pulse-stack.description: A portrait timing arcade game about aligning a pulsing beam with a growing neon tower.
pulse-stack.feature3: Synthesized audio and a vector arena

orbit-snap.description: A portrait timing game where you align a moving node on a 360-degree orbital track.

ten-dash.tagline: Find the sum before the dash
ten-dash.description: A quick portrait puzzle about pairing number tiles to hit the target and keep the run moving.

echo-grid.tagline: Remember the colors. Echo the pattern.
echo-grid.description: A memory arcade game where you repeat color and melody sequences on a four-pad neon grid.

signal-switch.description: A portrait reaction game set at a neon four-way intersection where the right directional signal keeps the run alive.

words.tagline: A word puzzle book that keeps you coming back
words.description: An offline word-puzzle book with themed collections, 555 puzzles, and progress you can earn across days.
words.feature3: Achievements for puzzles, words, themes, and active days

critter-sort.tagline: Uncover the critters. Sort the rescue.
critter-sort.description: A rescue-cell sorting puzzle where you uncover hidden pieces and move critters into two empty bins across deterministic worlds.
critter-sort.feature2: Question-mark blocks reveal as you uncover them
critter-sort.feature3: Daily puzzles, hints, undo, and local progress

perfect-produce.description: A local-first produce comparison app that scores visible cues against a shopper's intended use without claiming food-safety detection.
perfect-produce.feature2: Package Scan and research-labeled Watermelon mode
perfect-produce.feature3: Confidence, coverage, inventory, and outcome feedback

capybara-cafe.tagline: A cozy café with a capybara crew
capybara-cafe.description: Keep a cheerful café moving, serve guests, and grow a warm little world built for relaxed, playful sessions.

site.libraryHeroTagline: Mobile utilities, playful games, and private browser tools—built to make everyday problems feel lighter.
site.libraryFutureBody: Kortex is now a real library: mobile utilities, local-first games, work helpers, and installable browser tools that all share one playful, privacy-minded home.

brew.description: Log recipes, calculate brew ratios, and keep tasting adjustments private on your device.

deposit.description: Keep room notes, condition photos, and inspection details together before deadlines blur.

focus.tagline: Name the work before the distraction
focus.description: Create one intentional focus block with a timer and a practical interruption plan.

guide.description: Prepare dependable Riverwalk, Ybor, and Busch Gardens outings before reception disappears.

memo.tagline: Turn a wandering thought into clarity
memo.description: Capture voice or text and structure it locally into notes, key points, and action items.

pantry.tagline: Check food recalls at the source
pantry.description: Search the official FDA enforcement feed for pantry and pet-food products.

proof.tagline: Capture the record while details are fresh
proof.description: Build a timestamped incident timeline with notes, references, photos, and documents.

recall.tagline: Keep a private household safety watch
recall.description: Check consumer products against the official U.S. CPSC recall feed.

return.description: Track deadlines and keep receipts with the purchase without granting inbox access.
